development_failures_and_fixes: Adding a guide inside the exact five-file sealed runtime caused 18 tests to fail; moved only the new guide to containers/README.md. Runtime policy and pins were not weakened.
A full suite started during final report hardening imported older code and failed two newly added residual-corruption tests. Final focused and full suites passed after all agents froze edits.

Windows scientific checks required PYTHONPATH=src;. because the default interpreter was not an editable install. Native temporary-directory permission errors were resolved with a fresh repository-scoped pytest base, not suppressed.
New report-test import spacing was normalized for current lint defaults; numerical sources and retained execution hashes were unchanged.

review_boundary: Different coding agents reviewed work they did not author. This is engineering review, not independent human scientific governance, observer blindness, calibrated observational controls, or protocol approval. GitHub CI status is recorded by the remote run, not asserted here.
